QuestInfo.name: Keep on Rolling
QuestInfo.0: Traveling around Maple World these days is so... boring. Something's missing.
QuestInfo.1: It must be a mount! The greatest thief of all time can't be seen hoofing about in his expensive loafers. Go ask #p1401000# about obtaining a ride.
QuestInfo.2: Perfect timing! #p1401000# said he had already ordered you a nice convertible. He is the greatest manservant in the history of Maple World.

0.0: Throughout my many luxurious travels, I've come to realize that I am far too metropolitan a person to spend my days wandering around with my own two feet.
0.1: Walking around is just not the most majestic way to get around.

yes.0: I really want a mount! In my day, mounts were confined to horses and very large monkeys, but the mounts these days are just amazing! I must to tell #p1401000# to get me one!

no.0: I don't NEED it, per se, but...

1.0: Hello, master. It has been some time since you've set foot upon the #m150000000#. I assume you're working to live up to those rather ample promises you made. \r\n#L0##bThat's not important right now, #p1401000#. What IS important is that I need a ride!#l\n#k
1.1: A ride, master?\r\n#L0##bI'm talking about a Mount! An awesome Mount to show the world what a high-roller I am! Have you seen the things these people are cruising around on?#l\n#k
1.2: Of course, master. I've already taken the liberty of ordering a ride suited to your particular tastes.
